text: Three students set out to film Deborah Logan, an elderly Virginia woman with Alzheimer's who lives with her daughter Sarah. Her decline turns strange: she speaks French about sacrifices and snakes, and the switchboard line of Henri Desjardins, a doctor who vanished after the [ritual murders of four young girls|wrong|human sacrifice], keeps ringing. The crew begins to suspect [Desjardins speaks through her|threat|being taken over], still chasing [a Monacan rite to make himself immortal|wants|cheating death and age], and that a young cancer patient named Cara [may be his fifth|who_suffers|young children].
